title: 3 things every booking page needs to convert.
styleLine: ONE CONSISTENT LINE ACROSS ALL IMAGES (critical). Cinematic editorial photography, shot as if by the SAME photographer on the SAME 35mm lens, same warm natural grade — deep navy shadows (#262B38) + warm cream light (#F7F8EA), rich but natural (NOT a heavy Instagram filter, NOT washed-out, NOT HDR). Modern boutique-hotel world: walnut wood, cream plaster, greenery, contemporary fixtures. NO dated props. Elegant, quiet, expensive. 4:5 (1080x1350). No text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces.
note: Path B — scene/organic. s3 is a DEVICE-COMPOSITE (blank white laptop → composite laptop-hero booking page). For the FEED proposal only the cover (s1) is needed first. Drop photos into assets/scene-06/ as s1..s5 .png.

slides.headline:
3 things every booking page
needs to ==convert==.
slides.sub: A pretty site doesn't pay. A converting one does.
slides.imagePrompt: A guest smiling gently while booking on a laptop at a bright modern café or home desk (three-quarter, face not clearly identifiable), warm daylight, plant and coffee, walnut and cream. Effortless, satisfying booking moment. LEAVE THE TOP THIRD a calm brighter wall for the headline; subject lower-right. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]

slides.title: ==Speed== under 2 seconds.
slides.body: Every extra second of load time drops conversions ~7%. On mobile, speed is the whole game.
slides.imagePrompt: Close-up of a phone in hand mid-tap at a warm café table (screen not readable, ambient glow), motion energy, latte and plant nearby. LEAVE THE BOTTOM THIRD calm and darker for text. The main subject or device must sit in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame, leaving a clean, uncluttered, darker LOWER ~40% for text. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]

slides.imageId: SCENE-06 / 3  (PHOTO + COMPOSITE — laptop, blank white screen)
slides.title: Prices & dates ((above the fold)).
slides.body: Availability, rate and the book button — visible the second the page opens. No hunting.
slides.imagePrompt: A modern open laptop (MacBook-style) on a clean walnut desk, plant and coffee, morning light. DEVICE-COMPOSITE SLIDE — read carefully. The laptop must be PERFECTLY STRAIGHT AND FRONT-ON: screen plane exactly parallel to the camera, ZERO rotation, ZERO tilt, no perspective, edges square to the frame. Its screen must be a COMPLETELY BLANK PURE-WHITE rectangle (#FFFFFF) — no UI, no text, no reflections, no glare, nothing overlapping it, all four corners fully visible with a little clearance. The device sits in the UPPER ~55% of the frame; the LOWER ~40% is a clean, empty, softly-shadowed darker surface for text. Deliver ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS PHOTOGRAPH natively in 4:5 (1080x1350). Do NOT letterbox, pad, extend or outpaint — no horizontal seam anywhere; the empty lower area must be part of the photographed scene (a real table top, floor or wall in shadow). [Apply the STYLE LINE.]

slides.title: One reason to book __here__, not there.
slides.body: Best-rate promise, free upgrade, late checkout — a perk the OTA legally can't show. Make it loud.
slides.imagePrompt: A warm detail of a boutique-hotel perk — a handwritten welcome card and a small upgrade on a bed or desk (no readable text), golden light, plants, cream linens. LEAVE THE TOP THIRD calm for text. The main subject or device must sit in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame, leaving a clean, uncluttered, darker LOWER ~40% for text. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]
